state_of_the_art_prior_art: Cache hierarchies and memory management units
proven_facts: Amdahl's Law limits the maximum theoretical speedup of a parallel system
Moore's Law describes the historical trend of transistor density doubling approximately every two years
Pipelining can increase instruction-level parallelism and improve CPU throughput
Cache hit rates significantly impact system performance
Thermal resistance equations govern heat dissipation in electronic systems

Impact of power management and thermal control systems on overall system performance
